gloss: to entwine; to entangle; to involve

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {絡|から}めていませんでした

definitions.explanation: To wind or wrap one thing around another.
In cooking, to coat ingredients with sauce or seasonings.
To include or involve something as part of a discussion or plan.

examples.english: Ivy is wrapped around the tree.
I wound the thread around my finger.

notes:
{絡|から}める is a transitive verb (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧). The intransitive pair is ⟦{絡|から}む→絡む：04366_karamu⟧ (to get tangled, to get involved).

ASPECT (ている):
⟦{絡|から}め→絡む：04366_karamu⟧て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates an ongoing action of entwining or involving.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- [A]⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧[B]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{絡|から}める - to wrap B around A
- ⟦ソース→ソース：17673_soosu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{絡|から}める - to coat with sauce
- ⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{絡|から}める - to bring a topic into discussion
- ⟦{絡|から}め{取|と}る→絡め取る：noentry⟧ - to capture by entangling

COOKING USAGE:
In recipes, {絡|から}める commonly means to toss ingredients so they are evenly coated with sauce or seasoning.

{絡|から}める VS ⟦{絡|から}む→絡む：04366_karamu⟧:
- {絡|から}める (transitive): to wrap/involve something
- ⟦{絡|から}む→絡む：04366_karamu⟧ (intransitive): to become entangled, to get involved
